checks.check: Redundant fire-and-forget in apiSession.ts is harmless (acceptable blocker)
checks.evidence: Dev report documents that apiSession.ts could not be edited due to pre-existing quality gate violations (constructor 123 lines, sendClaudeSessionMessage 64 lines). The redundant .catch() path (lines 413-424) will attempt a second updateMetadata after the handler already succeeded. Since the version was already incremented, the second attempt will likely fail with version mismatch and be silently swallowed. This is harmless - the title is already persisted when it runs. Not a band-aid fix.

No threshold lowering, no error swallowing on the primary path, no validation skip. The fix correctly converts fire-and-forget to awaited call. The redundant .catch() in apiSession.ts is a pre-existing pattern that is now a no-op on the success path.

No hardcoded URLs, secrets, IPs, or absolute paths in startHappyServer.ts. The 'Happy MCP' server name and '1.0.0' version are acceptable constants. Tool name 'change_title' matches the MCP tool identifier.

summary: Pipeline 6 (Bug #62 title change fix) passes. The primary fix in startHappyServer.ts correctly addresses the root cause: the change_title MCP handler now awaits updateMetadata via persistTitle() before returning success, and propagates failures as isError:true.
